text:
Lina: Quick sync — we're running the KW-silo experiment for the webinar landing this Thurs. Need redirects + schema + internal anchor cleanup. Who can triage?
Sam: I can take redirects and canonical rules. Send the URL list and desired canonical mapping.
Ben: I'll own internal linking and CTAs. Lina, can you confirm priority targets? :pushpin:
Lina: Priority targets: /webinars/benchmarking-inference, /resources/benchmarks, /blog/benchmarks-summary, gating at /gated/webinar. Desired canonical: blog -> resources. Need webinarEvent schema for gated page.
Sam: Ok. Draft redirect rules (to be applied as 301s):
```
# preserve utm and query
rewrite ^/old-webinar/(.*)$ /webinars/$1? permanent;
rewrite ^/benchmarks-old$ /resources/benchmarks? permanent;
# canonical meta on blog: <link rel="canonical" href="https://www.redwood.inference.com/resources/benchmarks" />
```
I'll add tests.
Maria: I'll drop JSON-LD for WebinarEvent into the CMS. Draft:
```
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Inference Benchmarking Webinar",
  "startDate": "2026-04-08T16:00:00-07:00",
  "location": {"@type": "VirtualLocation", "url": "https://redwood.inference.com/gated/webinar"},
  "isAccessibleForFree": "False",
  "organizer": {"@type": "Organization", "name": "Redwood Inference"}
}
```
Jamal: Ops note — make sure redirects preserve GA UTM params. We shouldn't 302 anything that drops utm_source.
Sam: Good call. Example nginx preserve rule:
```
if ($args) {
  return 301 https://$host$uri?$args;
}
```
Ben: On internal linking: I'll replace generic 'webinar' anchor text on top 5 high-traffic pages with keyword-rich anchors and exact target URLs. Lina — can you provide the exact anchor phrases?
Lina: Anchors:
- "Inference benchmarking webinar"
- "LLM inference performance benchmarks"
- "Benchmarking Redwood inference"
Maria: Schema note — for gated content set "isAccessibleForFree": false and include offers? No ratings.
Jamal: Scheduling: redirect sweep Monday 09:00 PT, smoke tests after apply. @Sam @Ben please verify.
Sam: Ack — will post smoke test results to #release-war-room and link here.
seo-bot: crawl-scan: found 3 canonical conflicts on /blog/benchmarks-summary -> flagged.
Ben: I'll fix the anchor links and remove duplicate canonicals. Thanks everyone :rocket:
